description: NVIDIA GPU series -> NVIDIA driver-lookup IDs (psid/pfid for their DriverManualLookup API). The DRIVER itself is fetched live from NVIDIA, never listed here. 'pattern' is a regex matched against the GPU name; FIRST match wins. Old cards (Kepler) get the last legacy driver NVIDIA still serves via the API.

nvidia.note: GeForce GTX 10 / GT 1030 (Pascal - NVIDIA no longer serves this via auto-lookup; falls back to manual page)
